methods.update: update(nowMs = now()) -> snapshot; caller drives frames
methods.snapshot: snapshot() -> {version, renderer, loaded, destroyed, state, expression, intent, epoch, generation, requestCount, pose, viseme, speech, reaction, error}
methods.startSpeech: startSpeech({events = [], duration = Infinity, clock, sample, epoch?}) -> boolean; clock and cue time are seconds; sample takes precedence
methods.stopSpeech: stopSpeech() -> boolean; cancels sampler generation and closes mouth next rendered frame; preserves intent
methods.setExpression: setExpression(id, {epoch?, durationMs?} = {}) -> boolean; finite duration is a visual reaction, 1..10000 ms; otherwise persistent intent
methods.reset: reset({epoch?} = {}) -> boolean; defaults epoch+1; stops speech and reactions, preserves emotional intent
methods.destroy: destroy() -> void; irreversible, no further rendering
methods.optional: setGaze, clearGaze, setListeningSignal, setActivity, clearActivity, resetActivities, previewActivity return explicit unsupported receipt

epochRule: Tagged events/samples below current epoch are rejected; higher epoch retires prior speech and reactions. Untagged calls are trusted current-caller input and cannot establish stale-event safety.
restRule: Inactive, rest, nonpositive amount, missing or failed samples force registered rest cel even for open-rest presets; rests need not carry epoch. Explicit invalid amount becomes zero; omitted amount defaults to one for a non-rest viseme and zero for rest. Finite amounts clamp to 0..1. Sample viseme and provenance remain available when the rendered mouth closes.
unknownExpression: Reject with false; retain prior intent.
assetRule: All 13 native preset IDs also accepted; native image bytes reused unchanged. No renderer transforms beyond original registration.
limitations: Caller owns audio sources, playback suspension, live intent and turn arbitration.
No internal animation loop; caller must update at least each 15 fps frame.
Snapshot describes last rendered pose; speech cancellation becomes visible on next frame.
No live runtime swap or activity catalog integration.
